hint: tap anywhere to go tent to tent

game.q: aaron leaves the first friend’s tent. what’s his next move?
opts: “tells the second friend the very same thing”

wrong.table: bold. but he didn’t ambush anyone.
wrong.popcorn: tempting. he went to the other tent instead.

game.right: YES. same words, second tent. now each believed the other was sorry.

end.line: two friends stopped talking. aaron went tent to tent until they hugged.
